5056280750659.baseName: Homescapes Red Berry Handmade Christmas Tree, Green and Red
5056280750659.variantName: Homescapes Red Berry Handmade Christmas Tree, Green and Red
5056280750659.sourceDescription:
Craftsmanship and festive detail Rich red berries nestle among frosted branches, dark leaves and small pine cones on this 60 cm tree. The berries are wired in securely, so they stay in place when you move it. Beaded faux snow adds a light, wintery dusting. It arrives dressed, so just place it on a side table, console table or Christmas centrepiece. Premium quality direct from the maker Homescapes has made home furnishings since 2000, selling direct from the maker with no retail mark-ups. A cement-filled base inside a jute sack gives the tree weight and keeps it steady on flat surfaces. Handle it gently, as the beaded faux snow may shed a little. Made for indoor use only, it also makes an easy gift for anyone short on space or time.
READY-DRESSED AND FROSTED: Frosted green branches, wired red berries, dark leaves and small pine cones come already in place. Beaded faux snow adds a crisp, wintery touch with no decorating needed
WEIGHTED, STEADY BASE: A cement-filled base sits inside a jute sack tied at the top. The weight helps this 60 cm tree stay upright on flat surfaces, unlike light tabletop trees that tip easily
SMALL SPACE FRIENDLY: Compact enough for side tables, console tables and Christmas centrepieces where a full-size tree will not fit. Style it with lanterns, candle holders or a table runner
DIRECT FROM THE MAKER: Precision-crafted by Homescapes and supplied direct from the maker, so you get quality festive decor at an honest price with no retail mark-ups
GENTLE INDOOR USE: Indoor use only. The berries are securely wired in, though the beaded faux snow may shed a little, so handle gently when moving or storing the tree
Artificial christmas tree type: Table top
Comes pre-assembled
With stand

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture

Versatile red and green colour scheme complements various Christmas themes.

A flexible finishing touch

5037204490059.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Velvet and PVC. Colour: Red. Product measurements: width 15.6 cm, height 16 cm. Quantity: 28 pack.
Reusable design allows these festive ornaments to be stored and enjoyed for many Christmas seasons.
Each bauble features a hanging cord for easy attachment to tree branches or other decorative displays.
Crafted from soft velvet and durable PVC, offering a rich texture and vibrant red colour for your tree.
Generous 28-pack quantity provides ample coverage to fully decorate your Christmas tree with ease.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: Hanging cord
Hanger included

5075660348859.sourceDescription:
Christmas Elf Decoration
This Christmas elf decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and PVC construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Self Adhesive
The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: PVC. Colour: White. Stated size: 3.2 x 300 cm. Product weight: 0.3 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive Christmas elf design adds a charming decorative touch to your holiday display.
Self-adhesive backing allows for quick and easy application to compatible surfaces without tools.
Water-resistant PVC construction ensures durability and suitability for occasional moisture exposure.
Compact single item size of 3.2 x 300 cm fits neatly into various home decoration arrangements.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 1x Christmas Elf Decoration

5056797099159.sourceDescription:
Add a touch of winter luxury to your home with this light up snowflake from MySmartBuy. The six-armed snowflake, with its open ring centre and crisp branching tips, is densely wrapped in 720 warm white micro LEDs, creating a rich, sparkling glow that makes a stunning focal point in a window. The stylish champagne gold metal frame stands on slim legs above a flat base, so it sits neatly and securely on windowsills, tabletops, sideboards and mantelpieces. At 45cm, it is a versatile size that makes an impact without taking over the room, and looks just as elegant unlit during the day. It is supplied with a 5m cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening and greets passers-by with a warm festive glow. Pair it with the matching 45cm champagne gold Christmas tree for a coordinated window display, or group it with candles and greenery for an elegant seasonal look that works all winter long. These baubles are supplied in a handy box, making them easy to store away neatly after the season and reuse year after year. With their mixed surface finishes and bold black appearance, they add depth and contrast to a festive scheme, whether you are dressing a modern interior or coordinating a traditional Christmas setup. Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Timer Function
A timer provides a way to organise the operating period. Set the available timing option to suit the activity and adjust it when your routine changes.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.
